pair_a.read_back: After each write, head-object each key and compare ContentLength with the local gzip size, ContentType with application/gzip, and the object's row count and asOfDate with the pull's own log line; any mismatch fails the act for that key and is recorded.
pair_a.rollback_per_key: Per key, the rollback removes that key's new version only, so the prior state (absent) returns; the bucket is versioned. A delete is Andrew's act and no key is deleted by the worker. No other key is touched.
pair_a.absent_at_source_policy: A key is read ABSENT before the act; when the vendor returns nothing for a day, the day is recorded ABSENT-AT-SOURCE with the response status and an empty key is never written; a tolerated pull failure in the chain is not a write.

Timezone: classic EventBridge rules are UTC-only; cron(15 11) fires at 07:15 EDT and 06:15 EST. A 06:00 New York fold that holds across the EDT to EST change on 2026-11-01 needs aws_scheduler_schedule with schedule_expression_timezone. Precedent in the tree: infra/aws/terraform/inf-pipeline/inf-portal-publisher-floor.tf lines 107-112 (schedule_expression_timezone and a per-schedule scheduler role).

Chain catalog: the rows for INF_API_PULL_POSITIONS_DAILY (line 293), INF_API_PULL_TXN (line 295) and INF_API_PULL_PERF (line 297) of orion-gold-dispatch.sh carry no {date} token and run with their default flags only. run_chain refuses --run-date for date-agnostic steps. A past-day re-run through these steps therefore needs a catalog change to an S3 object outside this repository. This is a BLOCKING surprise row; through_chain_steps is recorded true only on the condition that the catalog row carries the day argument at the act.

Tolerated failure: in the dispatch script the pull branch logs WARN and the chain proceeds when a pull fails or times out. A green chain can therefore leave a day's key absent. ABSENT-AT-SOURCE must be read from the key itself, never from the chain status.
